title: Report a Room Problem
wrap_friend: 你剛剛完成了一段 A2 住宿服務情境，說明需求、聽懂回覆，並確認下一步。
learner_goal: Report a simple room problem and confirm the next step.
register_notes: Broad everyday English hotel-service register; polite, short A2 responses; no complaint escalation.
support_text: Report a small room problem and confirm what the hotel staff will do next.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Hello. How can I help you?
turns.speak: Hello. How can I help you?

choices.surface: There are no towels in my room. Could you help?
choices.translation: 我的房間裡沒有毛巾。可以幫忙嗎？
choices.speak: There are no towels in my room. Could you help?

choices.surface: I want to book a room.
choices.speak: I want to book a room.
choices.feedback: You need to report a room problem, not make a booking.
Compensation is outside this A2 task.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: Yes, I will bring towels right away.
turns.speak: Yes, I will bring towels right away.
turns.translation: 好的，我馬上拿毛巾過去。

friend.hint: Confirm what the staff will do.

inline_explain.title: A2 pattern
inline_explain.explain: A useful pattern for this accommodation situation.

choices.surface: You will change my room, right?
choices.speak: You will change my room, right?
choices.feedback: The staff said towels, not a room change.
This is a hotel service situation, not transport.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: It will take about ten minutes.
turns.speak: It will take about ten minutes.

choices.surface: I check out in one hour.
choices.speak: I check out in one hour.
choices.feedback: This is about towel delivery time, not checkout.

choices.surface: I need to go to the hospital.
choices.speak: I need to go to the hospital.
choices.feedback: Medical content is outside this task.

turns.speaker: npc
turns.surface: I will send them to your room.
turns.speak: I will send them to your room.

choices.surface: Thank you. I will wait in my room.
choices.speak: Thank you. I will wait in my room.

choices.feedback: Refund rules are outside this simple room problem task.
That is a restaurant order, not hotel room service.
